premises.text: Multichannel selling lifts sales but is tedious; merchants must replicate listings, orders, and inventory tracking across platforms without central real-time sync
premises.evidence_span: Multichannel selling can be tedious, time-consuming, and extremely difficult to manage in real time

premises.text: Syncommerce dashboard lets merchants sell, track, and manage inventory across channels simultaneously with bulk publish and real-time multi-directional inventory sync
premises.evidence_span: centralized dashboard allows online merchants to sell, track, and manage inventory across multiple sales channels simultaneously

premises.text: Affordable SMB-focused offering with customizable sync differs from large-biz or incomplete competitor tools
premises.evidence_span: provides affordable and optimized solutions for small businesses

premises.text: Monthly subscription $40–$200 in tiers by products listed and channels connected
premises.evidence_span: monthly subscription ranges from $40 to $200 per month

premises.text: Integrations include Shopify, eBay, Etsy, and newly Amazon, targeting cross-platform merchants in North America and Europe then Asia/Africa
premises.evidence_span: integrations with Shopify, eBay, and Etsy

value.text: Sell more across channels while working less through centralized multichannel retailing

secondary_value.text: Increase sales by about 190% via selling on more than one channel
secondary_value.evidence_span: selling on more than one channel increases her sale on average by 190%

causal_links.evidence_span: lack of efficiency and central management across platforms
three pricing tiers are based on the number of products listed and channels connected

notes: Demo publish/sync flow folded into dashboard mechanism. Cumulative revenue/merchant counts excluded as traction. Competitor contrasts folded into SMB/real-time differentiation premise.
